notes.title: Early Access Roadmap for Eydigard
notes.notes: [p]Greetings adventurers,[/p][p]Eydigard has come a long way since our early access launch, and we’re thrilled with how the adventure has been shaping up. You’ve been reclaiming farms, solving mysteries, and testing your strength against the Fossegrim, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the support.[/p][p]Now it’s time to talk about what’s next. Our roadmap highlights four big patches throughout early access, bringing even more to explore.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281816/03d0a2c36a54400fe0661c7646a621c7cd2c7f96.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each update builds on what’s already in the game, adding more ways to play and explore. Much of this comes directly from your feedback, and it’s helping us shape the direction of development. We’re excited to keep rolling out these updates and to keep building Eydigard together.[/p][p][/p][p]– The Frostisen Studio Team[/p]

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 4 August
notes.notes:
[p]While we're building up for our next major content update, we've added some more graphic settings and quality-of-life features that have been requested by players. We've also continued our UI overhaul. Lastly, after hours and hours of meticulous debugging, we found and fixed the performance issue that had caused some frame drops since the June patch. The good news is that we squeezed in a few more optimizations along the way.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A new chest has appeared in your player house and reclaimed farms. Its contents are shared across all locations. Perhaps a gift from the "Gardsvord", the old farm spirits.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now transfer and drop gold. No more excuses for not sharing your precious skillings with your friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to turn Upscaling off. For purists, skeptics, and people whose PCs could heat a small cabin[/p][/*][*][p]Added settings to set a max frame rate[/p][/*][*][p]Added player setting for display mode (fullscreen or windowed)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Major rework of UI buttons and tabs. All buttons and tabs are now more unified in design, and properly respond to hover, click, and selection states.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with outdoor ground textures that caused a massive drop in frame rate
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 25 July
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added options to enable Vsync
[*]Dialogue responses can now be selected using hotkeys
[*]Added new fur type for the Lynx form (Supporter Pack only)
[*]Added more in-game hints
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Major architectural change to tree rendering:
The old GPU instanced indirect tree system has been replaced with a fully data-oriented approach using Unity’s Entities system (ECS). This improves culling, batching, and logic control of vegetation, offering significatly better performance and more flexibility for gameplay features.
[*]Updated lighting and atmosphere in the Prologue
[*]Many general visual improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Eydigard Update Notes – May 02
notes.notes:
Fixes & Improvements:

[list]
[*] Player Gear Drop: Items now correctly drop at the death position, not the final ragdoll location. This fixes the issue where gear could sink through the world if the player died during a "get-up" transition.
[*]     Lighting: Improved nighttime lighting and resolved several light probe issues. Visibility and atmosphere should now feel more consistent.
[*]     Quest Fixes: Several bugs affecting quest progression have been resolved.
[*]     UI Navigation (Controllers): Fixed hand controller navigation issues in menus and UI elements.
[*]     Localization: Addressed bugs affecting localization of item names and UI. Journal categories now update correctly when changing language mid-session.
[*]     Character Clipping: Fixed a bug where the male player character’s head would clip through clothing while walking.
[*]     Controller Support: Added controller button icons for the ability bar and the in-game cheat sheet.
[*]     Farm Upgrades: Fixed a bug where upgrades to farms were not always saving correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Eydigard Launches April 29!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281816/13f030e8107bd235850b51933617f65bee78208e.png[/img]

[h1]Eydigard is launching into Early Access on April 29![/h1]


The moment is finally here. After years of dedicated development, the team at Frostisen Studio is proud to announce that Eydigard will launch into Steam Early Access on April 29. 

Set in a hauntingly beautiful world inspired by Norwegian and Sámi folklore, Eydigard invites players to transform into powerful animals, explore abandoned lands, and uncover the mysteries left behind after the black plague.

[h3]What to expect in Early Access:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Shapeshifting Gameplay[/b] – Switch between human and animal forms to fight, explore, and solve puzzles.
[*] [b]Folklore-Based Enemies[/b] – Battle creatures inspired by Norwegian and Sámi folklore.
[*] [b]Co-op Multiplayer (1-6 Players)[/b] – Join forces with friends or explore solo in a dynamic world shaped by your actions.
[*] [b]Settlement Restoration & Upgrades[/b] – Cleanse cursed farms and upgrade them into thriving bases.
[/list]
 
We can't wait for you to dive in and shape the journey alongside us.

— Jostein, Stian, Casper, Vegard, Steffen, and Lars
Frostisen Studio

Wishlist today and see you on April 29!

notes.title: Eydigard Beta Access From Steam
notes.notes:
The Eydigard playtest beta is now live on Steam and the first players have already gained access. 

Where you previously had to go through our studio webpage, you can now request your beta access directly from the Steam store page. We are hoping to see even more eager beta testers join our ranks in the coming months and value your feedback on how we can make Eydigard as great as possible toward our 2025 early access. 

Lots of love,

The Frostisen Studio Team

notes.title: Eydigard starting closed beta testing this june!
notes.notes:
Big news from us here at Frostisen Studio: Eydigard is hitting closed beta this June and you are invited to join us! 

We’ve been hard at work crafting characters, designing new biomes, and creating new features for you to discover with your friends. It’s been a while since our last update, but we have had all hands on deck to get the beta ready for playtesting.

We’re super excited to finally let you guys get hands-on with Eydigard. If you’re keen to dive in and don't mind squashing a few bugs along the way, you can sign up for the beta on our website. It’s a big moment for us, seeing the game transform from ideas to something you can play, and we’re pumped to bring even more to the table in the upcoming months.

We’d love for you to join our community, share your thoughts, and help shape the game’s future.  Join the Discord to chat with us, and get the latest updates firsthand. Plus, if you could wishlist Eydigard and tell your friends to do the same, that’d be awesome. It really makes a difference for us.

Thanks for all the support so far. We can’t wait for you to see what we’ve been working on.

Catch you in Eydigard,
The Frostisen Team
